high_level_description: The image shows a handwritten note on a piece of white paper. The note is written in blue ink with the title "Dear Veterans" in red ink at the top. The body of the note expresses gratitude to veterans for their service, stating that it feels inadequate to thank them properly. It highlights the gratitude felt for their courage and sacrifice in keeping others safe and protecting freedom and way of life. The note also acknowledges the time spent away from home for the good of the country and assures that this time will never be forgotten.
